text: {"923":{"about":["rustc_errors","rustc_error_codes"],"refers":[],"why":"Diagnostic error codes are attached and emitted by rustc_errors and link to extended explanations maintained in the error-code index."},"924":{"about":["rustc_errors"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_errors represents diagnostics, including the fact that an error code may be absent."},"925":{"about":["rustc_lint","rustc_errors"],"refers":[],"why":"Lint diagnostics are produced by rustc_lint through rustc_errors and ordinarily omit error codes."},"926":{"about":["rustc_errors"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_errors defines and emits the primary diagnostic message describing the problem."},"927":{"about":["rustc_errors"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_errors' primary diagnostic messages are designed to be understandable independently."}}
